landing.heroDescription: An app for notes, files, summaries, quizzes and a calendar within your groups. Organize your studies in one place.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for your studies
landing.featuresDescription: Start learning on solid foundations. The app includes all the essential tools to build a knowledge base with your group.
landing.feature1Description: Share notes, presentations and class materials with your entire group.
landing.feature2Description: Manage knowledge through automatic summaries and test yourself with interactive quizzes.
landing.feature3Description: Track important deadlines, tests, exams and group meetings in an integrated calendar.
landing.feature4Description: Organize into groups, exchange materials and stay up to date with your field of study.
landing.ctaDescription: Join other students and organize your studies with us. Start using it for free today.
